_comment: Shared cases for Opas's phrase matcher, read by BOTH implementations'
backend/tests/test_opas_capabilities.py. One table, two readers — so a
change made to one matcher and not the other goes red instead of drifting.
`entries` names the capability ids the caller was given. `expect` is the id
that must resolve, or null for nothing.
⚠️ The phrases themselves are NOT duplicated here. They live in the server
registry and travel to the client in the payload; a copy here would be a
third place to keep in step.

cases.why: a curly apostrophe is what a Mac types; it must normalise to the straight one
case and runs of whitespace are normalised

cases.typed: I need to upload hours for this week

cases.why: ⚠️ THE DISCRIMINATING CASE. Contains 'dues', which belongs to the week entry, so an exact-match pass must run before containment.
nothing in the payroll registry answers an orders request
⚠️ a caller given no entries resolves nothing, however exactly she types
the upload is a change entry; a view-only caller was never given it
